newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit weakens but off lows against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit weakens but off lows against dollar.

text.p: The ringgit weakened against the dollar but recovered from the day's lows on profit-taking, dealers said.
Year-end demand for the dollar had earlier pressured the ringgit, they said, adding that speculation of a trade deficit in October had also prompted players to cut ringgit positions.

"Earlier this week some market players bought up the ringgit on the expectation that an October trade surplus would be announced. There is now talk in the market that the October trade balance could show a deficit as high as 700 million ringgit," research firm I.D.E.A. said in an early comment.
October trade data is expected to be released soon. Malaysia recorded hefty trade surpluses in August and September.
Dealers said buying by U.S. funds pushed the dollar/ringgit from 2.5230 to 2.5260 in the morning.
They said the dollar's unexpected recovery against the majors after an overnight drop also weighed on the ringgit.

However, the ringgit's weakness would be limited unless the dollar made further strong gains, the dealers added. They expect the dollar's rise to be capped at 2.5280. At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5247/54 a dollar against 2.5225/35 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Thursday.
